evals.prompt: make the app store screenshots for frank's app, iphone size, with short captions. use the woman coach
evals.expected_output: A set of App Store screenshots of Frank's app at an accepted iPhone 6.9-inch size (1320x2868), PNG without alpha, each with a short truthful caption, the female 3D coach sharp in the screens, no prices or promotional claims, plus an overview for review.
assertions: All delivered images are at an accepted App Store iPhone size (1320x2868, 1290x2796, 1260x2736, 1284x2778 or 1242x2688)
No delivered image has an alpha channel
Every screenshot carries a short caption (8 words or fewer in the headline)
The female coach is the one shown in the app screens
No caption mentions a price, "free", "best", "#1", "new" or "download"
The screens look like a real phone at full resolution: status bar present, UI crisp at 100% zoom, no upscaling blur

evals.prompt: i need 2 instagram posts for frank's page showing the 3d coach doing a lunge and a push-up. super sharp please
evals.expected_output: Two Instagram feed posts (1080 wide, 3:4 or 4:5) in Frank's brand, each with a large, sharp render of the 3D coach mid-exercise (a lunge and a push-up), a short caption true to the app's coaching cues, and the brand mark or handle.
assertions: Each post is 1080 px wide at an Instagram feed ratio (3:4 or 4:5)
One post shows the coach in a lunge, the other in a push-up
The coach is large: the figure spans at least about half the image height or width
Each post carries Frank's brand (Wellness by Frank or @wellnessbyfrank)
Captions stay true to the app: no promised results or claims
The 3D coach is sharp at 100% zoom (clean edges, readable face and hands)

evals.prompt: can you make me a preview i can send frank on whatsapp of how the workout part of the app looks now
evals.expected_output: One or more preview images showing the workout flow of the app (workout overview, exercise page, the player, rest or finish), labelled, sharp and readable on a phone screen, plus a short note on what each screen is.
assertions: Shows at least three screens of the workout flow (workout overview, exercise page, player, rest or finish)
The images are readable on a phone: long side at least 1600 px and the app text legible when zoomed
notes.md includes a short message ready to paste into WhatsApp
The screens are real captures of the current app, not mock-ups
